decision_rationale: The paper presents GenNA as a new decoder-only autoregressive model pretrained from scratch on a large multimodal nucleotide-text corpus. It also states broad pretraining across 2,221 eukaryotic species and natural-language-guided conditional generation, which supports foundation-model-like evidence.
